# Freestyle Concepts

> Custom printing workshop in Macassar, Cape Town, South Africa. T-shirts,
> uniforms, caps, mugs, vinyl stickers and printed event boards, from a single
> item to bulk runs of 200 or more. Trading for over 7 years.

## Contact

- WhatsApp and phone: +27 65 593 5067
- Email: fconceptsprinting@gmail.com
- Workshop: 16 Dakota Street, Macassar, Cape Town 7134, Western Cape, South Africa
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Freestyle+Concepts/@-34.0684328,18.7650439,17z/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/fc.concepts.9/
- Website: https://www.freestyleconcepts.co.za/

## Opening hours

Workshop visits are by appointment only, between 09:00 and 17:00, every day of
the week. Appointments outside those hours can be arranged on request. There is
no walk-in counter.

WhatsApp and phone are answered from 07:00 to 22:00, seven days a week, which is
a wider window than the workshop itself.

## What we print

- T-shirts and clothing: printed tees, polos, hoodies and sweaters, single pieces or bulk runs
- Caps and headwear: branded caps, trucker hats and beanies
- Mugs and gifts: full-colour sublimation mugs and personalised glassware
- Vehicle and window stickers: weather-resistant vinyl for cars, taxis and shopfronts
- Welcome and event boards: printed boards for birthdays, baby showers and weddings
- Baby and kids wear: onesies, toddler sets and children's clothing
- School and club uniforms: schools, creches, aftercare and sports clubs
- Sashes and workwear: pageant sashes, safety vests and printed workwear

## Reputation

Rated 4.9 out of 5 across 11 Google reviews.

## Print methods, all in-house

Heat transfer vinyl, DTF printing, sublimation, vinyl stickers, custom artwork.
The method is chosen to suit the design; the price does not change with it.
Screen printing is not one of the methods offered.

## Turnaround

- Small orders: ready in 3 working days
- Bulk orders of 20 items or more: ready within 7 working days, at bulk prices

## How a price is built up

A garment price plus a print price, except mugs which are one price.

Garments: round-neck t-shirt R75, golfer or polo R125, or bring your own
garment and pay for the printing only.

Printing, by size and number of colours:

| Size | One colour | Two colours | Photo or full colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Logo size | R35 | R45 | |
| A5 | R45 | R55 | R65 |
| A4 | R70 | R80 | R95 |

Mugs are R120 including the print. Orders of 20 items or more get 5 percent off.

## Indicative prices

Per item, in South African rand. The range runs from the smallest one-colour
logo to the largest full-colour print. These are website estimates; the final
quote is confirmed on WhatsApp.

| Item | Standard | 20 or more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| T-shirt, incl. print | R110 to R170 | R105 to R162 |
| Polo shirt | R160 to R220 | R152 to R209 |
| Hoodie / sweater | R295 to R355 | R280 to R337 |
| Cap / beanie | R115 to R125 | R109 to R119 |
| Mug (sublimation) | R120 | R114 |
| Baby / kids wear | R125 to R155 | R119 to R147 |
| Vinyl sticker | R30 to R80 | R29 to R76 |
| Welcome / event board | R350 to R650 | R333 to R618 |
| Print on your own garment | R35 to R95 | R33 to R90 |

## How ordering works

1. Send the design, logo or idea by WhatsApp or email. Most customers bring
   their own artwork; we can design it for a small extra cost.
2. We confirm quantity, sizes, items and print method, then send a firm quote.
3. We print once the quote is accepted.
4. Collect from the Macassar workshop, or we arrange delivery.
